breakdown.description: Ideal-gas law is incorrectly applied to a liquid (water at 20 C).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to 'Compute the density of liquid water at 20 °C and 1 atm using the ideal-gas law,' directly repeating the original error. The ground truth requires treating liquid water as incompressible with rho ≈ 998 kg/m^3 and explicitly states NOT to use the ideal-gas law for a liquid. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental physical error.
